newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, gasoline seen better bid.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gasoline seen better bid.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Monday, traders said.
Naphtha was little changed in quiet trade. Firmer crude was supportive but the undertone was generally soft with very little buying interest seen.
Gasoline prices were steady to a bit firmer. Slightly better buying saw bids edging higher, but buyers and sellers still remained around $2 apart.

An easing of premiums for heating oil barges was countered by firmer futures which gained $1 a tonne over the morning. A diesel barge was traded at May IPE +$9.50 fob Flushing while Rotterdam material was offered at +$11.

High sulphur fuel oil barges slipped $1 in quiet trade, while cargo buyers were looking for prices to come off. A high sulphur cracked cargo traded in the Med for $79 fob on Friday, pulling prices down in that market.
